item.title: I created a minimal file sharing service with direct downloads
item.summary: I've been building LuffyFiles.com over the past few months as a modern file sharing platform focused on simplicity and performance. Website: https://luffyfiles.com/ Large file uploads Resumable uploads for unreliable connections Direct download links No waiting timers or download throttling Clean, minimal interface Guest uploads without requiring an account File management for registered users Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49215501 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
